terms.comment: vīcānus, vīcāna, vīcānum — of the village.

phrases.latin: per vīcum, ubi canēs quemque praetereuntem lātrant
phrases.english: through the village, where the dogs bark at everyone who passes

sources: Lewis & Short: vicus · Lewis & Short: vicanus
